findings.summary: The instantiation registry does not enforce deterministic entry ordering and its uniqueness rule prevents multiple closed-world instantiations of one TypeScript declaration.
evidence: work/002-m0-analysis-infrastructure/spec.md:51,64 requires a deterministic registry for exact closed-world instantiations and deterministic ordering.
scripts/analysis-infrastructure-lib.mjs:32-46 checks duplicate declarationIdentity, duplicate fsharpSymbol, and expression normalization, but performs no ordering check.
Observable reproduction on 2fc89ce400965cbadb281d69ce2aee677b422b99: validateInstantiationEntries accepted an intentionally unsorted Add/Tuple entry array with [] diagnostics.

Observable reproduction on 2fc89ce400965cbadb281d69ce2aee677b422b99: two normalized Tuple instantiations with distinct expressions and F# symbols produced ["duplicate declarationIdentity: @babylonjs/core|@babylonjs/core/types|Tuple"].

docs/2026-08-31T072958Z-missing-exports-design-roadmap.md:projection mechanism 5 requires one recorded mapping for each normalized instantiation, so later milestones necessarily need multiple entries for declarations such as Tuple.
resolution_evidence: scripts/analysis-infrastructure-lib.mjs at 528315802c35e77d413c3bb59be43f6daa0e1e99 keys uniqueness by declarationIdentity plus normalized typeScriptExpression and rejects non-increasing canonical key order.

scripts/test-analysis-infrastructure.mjs at 528315802c35e77d413c3bb59be43f6daa0e1e99 adds passing coverage for two ordered Tuple instantiations and negative coverage for out-of-order and duplicate normalized instantiations.
Confirmation rerun: node --test scripts/test-analysis-infrastructure.mjs passed all 8 tests, including the repaired registry cases.

Round-2 confirmation at da89a968e7d13dca3e7622d023c02946813beba7 reran npm run analysis:test and again passed all 8 tests, including ordered multi-instantiation, duplicate-instantiation, and ordering coverage.

findings.summary: Blocked-family rules are keyed only by export name, so the analyzer does not enforce the plan's exact package/module/export identities.
evidence: work/002-m0-analysis-infrastructure/plan.md:29 requires the family registry to be keyed by exact package/module/export identity.
analysis/analysis-policy.json stores family exports as unqualified names, including a single PhysicsEngine name used to account for two distinct modules.
scripts/analysis-infrastructure-lib.mjs:78-103 selects a family with family.exports.includes(item.name); package and module are copied only after classification and never checked against policy.

Observable reproduction on 2fc89ce400965cbadb281d69ce2aee677b422b99: classifyBlockedExports classified evil|elsewhere|PhysicsEngine into the physics family with no diagnostics when the expected count was one. This permits a wrong-module same-name export to replace an intended identity while the count gate remains green.
scripts/test-analysis-infrastructure.mjs contains dependent-map and registry tests only; it has no classifier substitution, duplicate-identity, or wrong-module fixture.
resolution_evidence: analysis/analysis-policy.json at 528315802c35e77d413c3bb59be43f6daa0e1e99 lists all family members by exact package|module|export identity, including separate Physics v1 and v2 identities.
scripts/analysis-infrastructure-lib.mjs at 528315802c35e77d413c3bb59be43f6daa0e1e99 matches identityOf(item), reports duplicate policy identities, and reports duplicate blocked identities.
scripts/test-analysis-infrastructure.mjs at 528315802c35e77d413c3bb59be43f6daa0e1e99 adds wrong-module substitution and duplicate policy/blocked identity fixtures; the confirmation rerun passed both.
Round-2 confirmation at da89a968e7d13dca3e7622d023c02946813beba7 reran npm run analysis:test and again passed the wrong-module substitution and duplicate policy/blocked identity fixtures.

findings.summary: The committed evidence does not execute the required two-generation byte comparison or the planned maintained binding build/test, so the roadmap exit evidence overstates what was observed.
evidence: work/002-m0-analysis-infrastructure/spec.md:26 and :55 require two analysis generations with byte-identical results.
work/002-m0-analysis-infrastructure/plan.md:38 additionally requires generate-twice comparison, analysis:check, coverage:check, binding build/test, and a maintained-API diff assertion.
scripts/run-analysis-tests.mjs:7-16 executes only the fixture test, one generate-analysis-infrastructure.mjs --check invocation, and one generate-coverage.mjs --check invocation.

reports/m0-analysis.trx records only those three checks, while work/002-m0-analysis-infrastructure/evidence.yml EV001 and EV008 describe byte-identical repeated generation and EV006 claims VO-001 satisfied.

Independent review reran node --test scripts/test-analysis-infrastructure.mjs, node scripts/generate-analysis-infrastructure.mjs --check, and node --max-old-space-size=8192 scripts/generate-coverage.mjs --check successfully, but those commands still do not constitute two independent generations or a binding build/test.
